summary: Military aircraft, including fast jets, carry out high energy manoeuvres within 15 nautical miles of Cape Wrath, Monday to Thursday, up to 24,500 ft.
text:
MIL ACFT, INCLUDING FAST JETS, WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEVRES
WI 15NM RADIUS OF 583731N 0045958W (CAPE WRATH). ACFT MAY BE UNABLE 
TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01343 817218. AR-2026-11227/01.
